title: Coordinates and the Cartesian Plane
summary: Plotting points in all four quadrants, and using coordinates to describe shapes.

ib.note: The coordinate plane is MYP 2 Geometry and Algebra

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 13: Introduction to Graphs

objectives: I can read and plot points in all four quadrants.
I can name quadrants and points on the axes.
I can use coordinates to find missing corners of shapes.
misconceptions: Points on an axis belong to a quadrant.
